map.由视距丝间隔算水平距 D=K·s+C。: Compute horizontal distance D = K·s + C from the stadia interval.
map.视距常数 K=100、丝隔 s=1.5m、加常数 C≈0 → D=100×1.5: Stadia constant K=100, interval s=1.5 m, add constant C≈0 → D = 100×1.5 = 150 m; with vertical-angle reduction gives horizontal distance and height difference.
map.视距误差约 1/200–1/300，低于钢尺/RTK，宜草测与低等级用。: Stadia error about 1/200–1/300, lower than steel tape / RTK, suited to sketch surveys and low-grade work.
map.内对光 K=100、C≈0；D=K·s+C，s 为上丝下丝读数差。: Internally focused K=100, C≈0; D = K·s + C, s is the difference between upper and lower stadia hair readings.
map.受读数/大气影响，中长距离误差大，正式成果用测距仪/RTK。: Affected by reading / atmosphere, large error at mid-long range; use EDM / RTK for official results.
map.视距测量（本页代码口径，本页取加常数 C=0 的简化式）：水平距离 D=100×: Stadia surveying (page code convention, simplified with additive constant C=0): horizontal distance D=100×staff interval s×cos²α (α is the vertical angle, multiplying constant K=100, with no +C·cosα term); height difference=100×s×sinα×cosα; slope distance=100×s (m). Validation: no strict validation; empty values fall back to 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; at α=0 the horizontal distance equals the slope distance, and the larger |α|, the more horizontal distance is lost relative to slope distance (correction factor cos²α).
